newsitem.title: LEBANON: Roadside bomb kills two Lebanese civilians.
newsitem.headline: Roadside bomb kills two Lebanese civilians.

text.p: A roadside bomb killed two Lebanese civilian teenagers in south Lebanon on Monday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
A third civilian with the teenage boy and girl in a car that triggered the bomb north of Israel's occupation zone was in serious condition in hospital, the sources said.

Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas are fighting to drive Israeli forces and their local militia allies from the 15 km (nine-mile) wide zone, site of frequent clashes, roadside bombs and rocket attacks.
